description: This file defines a React functional component for a password input field with toggle functionality to show or hide the password. It also includes a toggle button component and exports a decorated password input that supports custom decorations and forwarding refs.

methods.name: Toggle
methods.description: A React functional component for toggling password visibility, rendering an icon button that switches between 'eye' and 'eye-off' icons based on the toggled state.

methods.name: DecoratedPasswordInput
methods.description: A React component that renders a password input with a toggle button to show or hide the password, supporting custom right-side decorations, forwarding refs, and managing internal toggle state.
